verdict: Ads are reaching people; lead capture is broken and being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $634 in Google Ads spend drove 133 clicks and 683 website sessions, but zero leads were recorded across every channel. The findings confirm this is a tracking and intake issue, not an ads problem — clicks are arriving but the system that captures and routes them as leads is not connected. Conversion tracking is being repaired and the lead intake path is being rebuilt to close the gap. You should expect confirmed leads to appear once the fix is verified, with a full end-to-end test targeted before the end of September.

watch_item.issue: Zero leads recorded despite active spend — conversion tracking and lead intake are not capturing the clicks coming in.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired and the full intake path is being re-tested end-to-end; paid landing pages are also being brought live so clicks have a proper destination.
